_doc: Generated by tools/gen-art.mjs from docs/portrait-prompts.md: the portraits redrawn in the room paintings' style (FLUX Kontext on Replicate). chars: per character its reference portrait (the doc's file) and candidates: file = the cut-out (RGBA, on the reference portrait's canvas), raw = the model's picture, model / version / seed / style / prompt as sent, cut = how it was keyed out, verdict = the Art Lab's (labs/art/) approve ("ok") or reject ("no") with its note, flip = mirrored on import, imported = the game file it became. The game reads the portraits from enemies.json art / cards.json player.art, never from here.
